arxiv-2106-12509.title: Reanalysis of experimental determinations of polariton-polariton interactions in microcavities
arxiv-2106-12509.creator: D. W. Snoke 1 , V. Hartwell 2 , J. Beaumariage 1 , S. Mukherjee 1 , Y. Yoon, 3 D. M. Myers 4 , M. Steger 5 , Z. Sun, 1 K. A. Nelson 6 , and L. N. Pfeiffer 7
arxiv-2106-12509.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by D. W. Snoke 1 , V. Hartwell 2 , J. Beaumariage 1 , S. Mukherjee 1 , Y. Yoon, 3 D. M. Myers 4 , M. Steger 5 , Z. Sun, 1 K. A. Nelson 6 , and L. N. Pfeiffer 7. The polariton-polariton interaction strength is an important parameter for all kinds of applications using the nonlinear properties of polaritons, such as optical switching and single-photon blockade devices.

arxiv-2208-14137.title: On the Trade-Off between Actionable Explanations and the Right to be Forgotten
arxiv-2208-14137.creator: Martin Pawelczyk, Tobias Leemann, Asia Biega, Gjergji Kasneci
arxiv-2208-14137.description: Abstract As machine learning (ML) models are increasingly being deployed in high-stakes applications, policymakers have suggested tighter data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). One key principle is the “right to be forgotten” which gives users the right to have their data deleted.

arxiv-2210-03242.title: Disentangling Mixtures of Unknown Causal Interventions Published as an oral paper [ KS21 ] at the 37 t ​ h 37^{th} Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI), 2021.
arxiv-2210-03242.creator: Abhinav Kumar, Gaurav Sinha
arxiv-2210-03242.description: Abstract In many real-world scenarios, such as gene knockout experiments, targeted interventions are often accompanied by unknown interventions at off-target sites. Moreover, different units can get randomly exposed to different unknown interventions, thereby creating a mixture of interventions. Identifying different components of this mixture can be very valuable in some applications.

arxiv-2303-17123.title: Masked and Adaptive Transformer for Exemplar Based Image Translation
arxiv-2303-17123.creator: Chang Jiang, Fei Gao, Biao Ma, Yuhao Lin, Nannan Wang, Gang Xu
arxiv-2303-17123.description: Abstract We present a novel framework for exemplar based image translation. Recent advanced methods for this task mainly focus on establishing cross-domain semantic correspondence, which sequentially dominates image generation in the manner of local style control. Unfortunately, cross-domain semantic matching is challenging; and matching errors ultimately degrade the quality of generated images.

arxiv-2410-23457.title: Approximation of maps from algebraic polyhedra to real algebraic varieties
arxiv-2410-23457.creator: Marcin Bilski, Wojciech Kucharz
arxiv-2410-23457.description: Abstract Given a finite simplicial complex 𝒦 \mathcal{K} in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} and a real algebraic variety Y , Y, by a 𝒦 \mathcal{K} -regular map | 𝒦 | → Y |\mathcal{K}|\rightarrow Y we mean a continuous map whose restriction to every simplex in 𝒦 \mathcal{K} is a regular map.

arxiv-2411-03920.title: RAGulator: Lightweight Out-of-Context Detectors for Grounded Text Generation
arxiv-2411-03920.creator: Ian Poey, Jiajun Liu, Qishuai Zhong, Adrien Chenailler
arxiv-2411-03920.description: Abstract Real-time detection of out-of-context LLM outputs is crucial for enterprises looking to safely adopt RAG applications. In this work, we train lightweight models to discriminate LLM-generated text that is semantically out-of-context from retrieved text documents. We preprocess a combination of summarisation and semantic textual similarity datasets to construct training data using minimal resources.

arxiv-2501-13835.title: A Globally Convergent Method for Computing B-stationary Points of Mathematical Programs with Equilibrium Constraints
arxiv-2501-13835.creator: Armin Nurkanović, Sven Leyffer
arxiv-2501-13835.description: Abstract This paper introduces a computationally efficient method that converges globally to B-stationary points of mathematical programs with equilibrium constraints (MPECs). B-stationarity is necessary for optimality and means that no feasible first-order direction can improve the objective. It can be certified by solving a linear program with equilibrium constraints (LPEC) constructed at a given feasible point.

arxiv-2512-18445.title: On the Universality of Transformer Architectures; How Much Attention Is Enough?
arxiv-2512-18445.creator: Amirreza Abbasi, Mohsen Hooshmand
arxiv-2512-18445.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Amirreza Abbasi, Mohsen Hooshmand. Transformers are crucial across many AI fields, such as large language models, computer vision, and reinforcement learning. This prominence stems from the architecture’s perceived universality and scalability compared to alternatives. This work examines the problem of universality in Transformers, reviews recent progress, including architectural refinements such as structural minimality and approximation rates, and surveys state-of-the-art advances that inform both theoretical and practical understanding.

pmc-10537382.title: 5-Nitrofuran-Tagged Oxazolyl Pyrazolopiperidines: Synthesis and Activity against ESKAPE Pathogens
pmc-10537382.creator: Elizaveta Rogacheva, Lyudmila Kraeva, Alexey Lukin, Lyubov Vinogradova, Kristina Komarova, Mikhail Chudinov, Maxim Gureev, Evgeny Chupakhin
pmc-10537382.description: A series of eight 5-nitrofuran-tagged oxazolyl tetrahydropyrazolopyridines (THPPs) has been prepared in six stages with excellent regioselectivity. The testing of these compounds against pathogens of the ESKAPE panel showed a good activity of lead compound 1-(2-methoxyethyl)-5-(5-nitro-2-furoyl)-3-(1,3-oxazol-5-yl)-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-pyrazolo[4,3-c] pyridine (13g), which is superior to nitrofurantoin. These results confirmed the benefit of combining a THPP scaffold with a nitrofuran warhead.

pmc-11382279.title: Electrowinning for Room-Temperature Ironmaking: Mapping the Electrochemical Aqueous Iron Interface
pmc-11382279.creator: Lance Kavalsky, Venkatasubramanian Viswanathan
pmc-11382279.description: A promising route toward room-temperature ironmaking is electrowinning, where iron ore dissolution is coupled with cation electrodeposition to grow pure iron. However, poor faradaic efficiencies against the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is a major bottleneck. To develop a mechanistic picture of this technology, we conduct a first-principles thermodynamic analysis of the Fe110 aqueous electrochemical interface.

pmc-11510713.title: BONCAT-iTRAQ Labelling Reveals Molecular Markers of Adaptive Responses in Toxoplasma gondii to Pyrimethamine Treatment
pmc-11510713.creator: John G. Mina, Anutthaman Parthasarathy, Exequiel O. Porta, Paul W. Denny, Karunakaran Kalesh
pmc-11510713.description: We employed a BONCAT-iTRAQ labelling approach to investigate newly synthesised proteins (NSPs) in Toxoplasma gondii subjected to varying concentrations of the antifolate drug pyrimethamine. Our results reveal that numerous NSPs exhibited altered expression levels in response to the drug, with significant upregulation observed at higher concentrations.

pmc-11626753.title: Exploring the efficacy of Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) in modulating local and systemic inflammation in experimental models of colitis
pmc-11626753.creator: Fatemeh Hesampour, Diane M Tshikudi, Charles N Bernstein, Jean-Eric Ghia
pmc-11626753.description: BackgroundCurrent inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatments often fail to achieve lasting remission and have adverse effects. Vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) offers a promising therapy due to its anti-inflammatory effects. Its invasive nature, however, has led to the development of non-invasive methods like transcutaneous auricular VNS (taVNS). This study assesses taVNS’s impact on acute colitis progression, inflammatory, anti-inflammatory, and apoptosis-related markers.

pmc-12409654.title: Casemanagers Positioned as Key Advance Care Planning Conversationalists in Oncology Care: A Qualitative Interview Study on the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals and Patients
pmc-12409654.creator: Anouk Putker, Marieke Perry, Jelmer Chalkiopoulos, Annika Piek, Yvonne Engels, Evelien Kuip
pmc-12409654.description: IntroductionThe increasing global cancer burden and advances in treatments have extended patients' life expectancy, leading to greater prognostic uncertainty and a higher demand for palliative care. Advance care planning (ACP) is essential in this context, ensuring that patients' future care aligns with their values and preferences. Oncology case managers, being nurses with specialized training, have emerged as key ACP conversationalists.

pmc-12469595.title: Patterns of Prescription Switching in a Uniform-Pricing System for Multi-Source Drugs: A Retrospective Population-Based Cohort Study
pmc-12469595.creator: Dong Han Kim, Song Hee Hong, Nikos M Maniadakis
pmc-12469595.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Generic drugs account for approximately 40% of the Korean prescription drug market, despite limited generic substitution at the point of dispensing. This suggests that switching between originator and generic drugs often occurs at the point of prescription. Physicians, in fact, have opposed pharmacy-level substitution due to concerns about the clinical equivalence of generics, despite the regulatory confirmation of their bioequivalence.

pmc-12594769.title: Evaluation of hybrid stroke quality indicators by integrating NIHSS and claims data for improved outcome prediction
pmc-12594769.creator: Thomas Datzmann, Caroline Lang, Falko Tesch, Melissa Spoden, Patrik Dröge, Franz Ehm, Ekkehard Schuler, Christos Krogias, Christian Günster, Jochen Schmitt, Christoph Gumbinger, Jessica Barlinn
pmc-12594769.description: Accurately measuring the quality of stroke care based on claims data alone is challenging. Traditional outcome metrics, e.g. mortality rates, do not capture the effectiveness of critical stroke care processes. We aimed to develop hybrid quality indicators (QIs) by integrating clinical stroke severity data with claims data.

pmc-13217694.title: RYR1+ skeletal muscle-derived extracellular vesicles are exercise responsive and associated with insulin action
pmc-13217694.creator: Xin Zhang, Christopher G. Vann, David B. Bartlett, Alastair Khodabukus, George A. Truskey, Nenad Bursac, Joseph A. Houmard, Johanna L. Johnson, Kim M. Huffman, Brian J. Andonian, William E. Kraus, Virginia Byers Kraus
pmc-13217694.description: BackgroundSkeletal muscle is a central regulator of insulin sensitivity and glucose homeostasis. The ryanodine receptor 1 (RYR1) is highly expressed in skeletal muscle and plays a key role in myogenic differentiation. We hypothesize that RYR1+ extracellular vesicles (EVs) represent a skeletal muscle-derived EV subpopulation whose abundance and small RNA (smRNA) cargo are associated with aging, insulin action, and exercise responsiveness.

pmc-13404403.creator: Laurence Monnais, Ludovico Gennaro Cobuccio, Pierre-Alex Crisinel, Amel Filali, Pascale Hancart Petitet, Heather MacDougall, Raul Antonio Necochea, Noémi Tousignant

Curcumin (CUR) possesses antioxidant, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory properties, but its practical application is limited by poor aqueous solubility and low bioavailability.
